metadata.description: Likely represents the domain associated with cookies for the UI.

suggestions: Ensure the value is correctly set to the domain your application uses.
Validate that the domain matches your production or staging environment.

metadata.description: Represents the name of the cookie used by the UI.

suggestions: Provide a meaningful cookie name that matches your application design.
Ensure the cookie name aligns with your security and naming standards.

metadata.description: Indicates the login type or authentication provider used by the UI.

suggestions: Ensure the login type corresponds to your authentication setup.
Document supported login types to avoid misconfigurations.

metadata.description: Represents the password for accessing the site. This is sensitive information.
security_risks: Exposure of passwords can lead to unauthorized access.
Passwords should be stored securely and never hardcoded.
recommended_practices: Use environment variables instead of hardcoding sensitive data.
Consider using a secrets management tool like AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault, or similar.

suggestions: Ensure this password is encrypted or stored securely.
Rotate passwords periodically to improve security.
Avoid sharing passwords in plaintext or committing them to version control.

metadata.description: Represents the username or email for accessing the site. This is sensitive information.
security_risks: Exposure of usernames or emails can lead to targeted attacks.
Should be handled securely in conjunction with passwords.
recommended_practices: Use environment variables to store sensitive information.
Consider obscuring email addresses in logs or error messages.

suggestions: Ensure this email is associated with a secure account.
Verify that this value matches the intended user or service account.
Avoid committing sensitive information to version control.
